Crawl Config
Crawl scope
Speed
More parallel requests crawl faster but put more load on the site. Set a per-second limit for fragile or shared servers (0 = no limit).
Limits
User-Agent
Some sites serve different pages (or block) search engine and AI bots. Each bot preset obeys its own robots.txt group.
HTTP Header
Extra request headers, such as Accept-Language. Sent to the crawled site only, never to other websites. Values of secret headers (tokens, cookies) are never saved in this browser.
Include
Exclude
URL Rewriting
Rewrites the URLs found during the crawl (never the start URL or uploaded lists), to avoid crawling the same page under several addresses.
Custom Search
Find pages that contain (or do not contain) a text or regex, in the HTML or in the visible text. Up to 10 searches; each becomes a filter and a column of the Custom Search tab. With Render every page in Chrome on, the search runs on the page as Chrome shows it.
Custom Extraction
Pull values out of every page with XPath, a CSS selector or a regex (e.g. prices, authors, SKUs). Up to 10 extractors; each becomes columns of the Custom Extraction tab. With Render every page in Chrome on, values are read from the page as Chrome shows it.
Custom JavaScript
Your own snippets run in Chrome on every rendered page; an extraction snippet returns a value per page (Custom JavaScript tab). Needs Render every page in Chrome below.
Rendering

Crawl Analysis
What is calculated after the crawl. Switched-off steps say "Not checked" in their tabs. Run again any time with Crawl Analysis > Start.
Authentication (login)
Advanced: login form fields
Only needed when the login form is unusual. CSS selectors, e.g. #email.
Works with JavaScript login pages too. For two-factor logins use Browser window; when the sign-in has a bot check (CAPTCHA), sign in with your own browser and use Paste cookies.
A real browser opens on the server and you log in yourself: two-factor codes and single sign-on work. When you press Done, only the login (cookies and site storage) is kept, for the next crawl. If the sign-in shows a bot check that doesn't let this window through, sign in with your own browser and use Paste cookies.

Sign in to the site in your own browser, copy its cookies and paste them here. ARACHNIX then crawls as you. This also works for sites whose sign-in has a bot check.

Sent with every request to this site only (never to other websites). For staging sites behind a token or basic auth.
